name: Creative Arts Hawaii
old_description: For more than 50 years, Creative Arts Hawaii has been helping Hawai‘i tell its story through custom apparel and design. What began in 1972 as a small print shop in Hilo has grown—through humble beginnings and hard work—into one of Hawai‘i’s leading providers of fully customized apparel and accessories, serving customers across the Big Island and throughout the state. Founded by Ernest Kurohara, who envisioned a full-service graphic design studio and the Big Island’s first commercial screen-printing facility, Creative Arts Hawaii began by supplying his retail stores with locally inspired designs. Since its establishment, the company has remained locally owned and operated, today led by Ernest’s son, Randy Kurohara, who carries forward his father’s vision of creativity, humility, and community commitment. As we have grown, we have stayed true to our values—caring for and giving back to the community that has supported us for generations, and being a responsible employer who values the well-being and growth of our team.
about:
Creative Arts Hawaii was founded in 1972 by Ernest Kurohara in Hilo, Hawaii. What started as a small print shop supplying Kurohara's retail stores with locally inspired designs has remained a family-owned operation, now led by his son Randy Kurohara. The company has stayed locally owned and operated for over five decades.

The shop provides a range of custom decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, digital transfers, heat-applied transfers, full-color banners, graphic design, and online pop-up stores. They produce fully custom apparel and accessories for clients across the Big Island and throughout the state, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers span businesses, festivals and events, schools, government institutions, family reunions, athletic teams, and nonprofit organizations. The company emphasizes serving the local community from Hilo to Kona and beyond.

Creative Arts Hawaii cites its deep local roots, community commitment, and values of creativity, humility, and responsible employment as differentiators. The firm describes itself as a one-stop shop with over 50 years of experience and a friendly, knowledgeable staff.
